questions.en: The highest peak of Bihar, the Someshwar Fort (880 m), is situated in which district?(
questions.hi: बिहार की सर्वोच्च चोटी 'सोमेश्वर किला' (880 मीटर) किस जिले में स्थित है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Someshwar Hills represent the foothills of the Shiwalik Himalayas extending along the northern border of West Champaran district, culminating at Someshwar Fort (880 m).
questions.tip: Valmiki National Park and Tiger Reserve, Bihar's only national park, is also situated in the Someshwar-Doon range in West Champaran.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Someshwar Hills represent the foothills of the Shiwalik Himalayas extending along the northern border of पश्चिम Champaran district, culminating at Someshwar Fort (880 m).
questions.tip_hi: वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान and Tiger Reserve, Bihar's only national park, is also situated in the Someshwar-Doon range in पश्चिम Champaran.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - Middle School Social Science
questions.en: The River Ganga enters the territory of Bihar in which district?
questions.hi: गंगा नदी बिहार के भू-भाग में किस जिले में प्रवेश करती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Ganga enters Bihar near Chausa in Buxar district from Uttar Pradesh and traverses 445 km eastward across 12 districts before exiting via Katihar into West Bengal.
questions.tip: Ganga in Bihar: Enters at Buxar (Chausa), longest stretch in Patna district (approx. 99 km), exits at Katihar/Bhagalpur.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The गंगा नदी enters Bihar near Chausa in Buxar district from Uttar Pradesh and traverses 445 किमी eastward across 12 districts before exiting via Katihar into पश्चिम Bengal.
questions.tip_hi: गंगा नदी in Bihar: Enters at Buxar (Chausa), longest stretch in Patna district (approx. 99 किमी), exits at Katihar/Bhagalpur.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - Senior Secondary Political Science
questions.en: The three-tier Panchayati Raj System was first inaugurated in India on 2nd October 1959 in which district?
questions.hi: भारत में त्रिस्तरीय पंचायती राज व्यवस्था का उद्घाटन सर्वप्रथम 2 अक्टूबर 1959 को किस जिले में हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurated democratic decentralization via the 3-tier Panchayati Raj system on Mahatma Gandhi's birthday in 1959 at Nagaur, Rajasthan, following the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee report.
questions.tip: 1st State to adopt Panchayati Raj = Rajasthan (Oct 1959); 2nd State = Andhra Pradesh (Nov 1959).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: प्रधानमंत्री जवाहरलाल नेहरू inaugurated democratic decentralization via the 3-tier पंचायती राज system on महात्मा गांधी's birthday in 1959 at Nagaur, Rajasthan, following the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee report.
questions.tip_hi: 1st State to adopt पंचायती राज = Rajasthan (Oct 1959); 2nd State = Andhra Pradesh (Nov 1959).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: A man walks 5 km East, turns right and walks 4 km, then turns left and walks 5 km. In which direction is he now facing?
questions.hi: एक व्यक्ति 5 किमी पूर्व दिशा में चलता है, दायें मुड़कर 4 किमी चलता है, फिर बायें मुड़कर 5 किमी चलता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा की ओर है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Initial direction = East. Turning right from East turns him to face South. Turning left from South turns him back to face East.
questions.tip: Right turn (+90 deg) followed by Left turn (-90 deg) cancels out; facing direction remains East.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Initial direction = पूर्व. Turning right from पूर्व turns him to face दक्षिण. Turning left from दक्षिण turns him back to face पूर्व.
questions.tip_hi: Right turn (+90 deg) followed by Left turn (-90 deg) cancels out; facing direction remains पूर्व.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Bihar was separated from the Bengal Presidency and created as an independent Province in which year?
questions.hi: बिहार को बंगाल प्रेसीडेंसी से अलग कर एक स्वतंत्र प्रांत के रूप में किस वर्ष गठित किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Announced at the Delhi Durbar in December 1911 by King George V, Bihar and Orissa were formally carved out of the Bengal Presidency effective from 1 April 1912. Orissa was subsequently separated from Bihar on 1 April 1936.
questions.tip: 1912 = Bihar & Orissa separated from Bengal; 1936 = Orissa separated from Bihar; 2000 = Jharkhand separated from Bihar.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Announced at the Delhi Durbar in दिसम्बर 1911 by King George V, Bihar and Orissa were formally carved out of the Bengal Presidency effective from 1 अप्रैल 1912. Orissa was subsequently separated from Bihar on 1 अप्रैल 1936.
questions.tip_hi: 1912 = Bihar & Orissa separated from Bengal; 1936 = Orissa separated from Bihar; 2000 = Jharkhand separated from Bihar.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Who were the principal leaders of the famous Santhal Rebellion of 1855-56 in the Rajmahal hills?
questions.hi: 1855-56 में राजमहल की पहाड़ियों में हुए प्रसिद्ध संथाल विद्रोह के प्रमुख नेता कौन थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Santhal Hool (Rebellion) was led by four brothers—Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, and Bhairav—in Damin-i-Koh against oppressive British revenue collectors, police, and mahajans (moneylenders).
questions.tip: Santhal Rebellion (1855-56) = Sidhu & Kanhu; Munda Ulgulan (1899-1900) = Birsa Munda.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Santhal Hool (Rebellion) was led by four brothers—Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, and Bhairav—in Damin-i-Koh against oppressive British revenue collectors, police, and mahajans (moneylenders).
questions.tip_hi: Santhal Rebellion (1855-56) = Sidhu & Kanhu; Munda Ulgulan (1899-1900) = Birsa Munda.

questions.en: Through how many States of India does the Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N) pass?(
questions.hi: कर्क रेखा (23°30' उत्तरी अक्षांश) भारत के कितने राज्यों से होकर गुजरती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian States from West to East: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
questions.tip: Mnemonic: 'मित्र पर गमछा झार' (Mizoram, Tripura, W.Bengal, Rajasthan, Gujarat, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian States from पश्चिम to पूर्व: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, पश्चिम Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
questions.tip_hi: Mnemonic: 'मित्र पर गमछा झार' (Mizoram, Tripura, W.Bengal, Rajasthan, Gujarat, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand).

questions.en: Which strait of water separates the island nation of Sri Lanka from the southeastern coast of India?
questions.hi: कौन-सा जलडमरूमध्य भारत के दक्षिण-पूर्वी तट को श्रीलंका से अलग करता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Palk Strait, situated between the Tamil Nadu coast of India and the Jaffna peninsula of Sri Lanka, connects the Bay of Bengal with Palk Bay and the Gulf of Mannar.
questions.tip: India and Sri Lanka = Palk Strait & Gulf of Mannar; Andaman and Nicobar = 10 Degree Channel.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Palk Strait, situated between the Tamil Nadu coast of India and the Jaffna peninsula of Sri Lanka, connects the Bay of Bengal with Palk Bay and the Gulf of Mannar.
questions.tip_hi: India and Sri Lanka = Palk Strait & Gulf of Mannar; Andaman and Nicobar = 10 डिग्री Channel.

questions.en: In which year was the 'Bihar Socialist Party' formally founded at the Anjuman Islamia Hall in Patna with Acharya Narendra Deva as President and Jayaprakash Narayan as General Secretary?
questions.hi: पटना के अंजुमन इस्लामिया हॉल में किस वर्ष आचार्य नरेंद्र देव की अध्यक्षता और जयप्रकाश नारायण के सचिव पद पर 'बिहार सोशलिस्ट पार्टी' का औपचारिक गठन हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: While an informal group formed in 1931, the formal founding convention of the Bihar Socialist Party (and foundation of Congress Socialist Party) took place at Anjuman Islamia Hall, Patna on 17 May 1934 under Acharya Narendra Deva.
questions.tip: Bihar Socialist Party formal convention = 1934 (Anjuman Islamia Hall, Patna); Narendra Deva (President) & JP (Secretary).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: While an informal group formed in 1931, the formal founding convention of the Bihar Socialist Party (and foundation of Congress Socialist Party) took place at Anjuman Islamia Hall, Patna on 17 मई 1934 under Acharya Narendra Deva.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Socialist Party formal convention = 1934 (Anjuman Islamia Hall, Patna); Narendra Deva (राष्ट्रपति) & JP (Secretary).

questions.en: The historic 'Lucknow Pact' of December 1916 was signed between which two major political organizations to present joint constitutional demands?
questions.hi: दिसंबर 1916 का ऐतिहासिक 'लखनऊ समझौता' किन दो प्रमुख राजनीतिक संगठनों के बीच संयुक्त संवैधानिक मांगों को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए हस्ताक्षरित हुआ था?
options: Indian National Congress and British Indian Association
Indian National Congress and All-India Muslim League
Home Rule League and Ghadar Party
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Indian National Congress and All-India Muslim League
questions.explanation: Under the efforts of Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Mohammad Ali Jinnah, the Congress and Muslim League held their joint session at Lucknow in 1916, accepting separate electorates and demanding provincial self-government.
questions.tip: Lucknow Pact 1916 = Congress & Muslim League alliance + Re-unification of Moderates and Extremists (President: A. C. Majumdar).
options_hi: Indian National Congress and British Indian Association
Indian National Congress and All-India Muslim League
Home Rule League and Ghadar Party
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Under the efforts of बाल गंगाधर तिलक and Mohammad Ali Jinnah, the Congress and Muslim League held their joint session at Lucknow in 1916, accepting separate electorates and demanding provincial self-government.
questions.tip_hi: Lucknow Pact 1916 = Congress & Muslim League alliance + Re-unification of Moderates and Extremists (राष्ट्रपति: A. C. Majumdar).

questions.en: Who served as the official President of the 'Champaran Agrarian Enquiry Committee' appointed by the Government of Bihar and Orissa in 1917, in which Mahatma Gandhi was a member?
questions.hi: 1917 में बिहार और उड़ीसा सरकार द्वारा गठित 'चंपारण कृषि जांच समिति' के अध्यक्ष कौन थे, जिसके एक सदस्य महात्मा गांधी भी थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sir Frank G. Sly (Commissioner of Central Provinces) was appointed President of the Champaran Agrarian Enquiry Committee by Lieutenant Governor Edward Gait. The committee unanimously recommended the abolition of the tinkathia system.
questions.tip: Champaran Agrarian Committee: President = F. G. Sly; Member = Mahatma Gandhi; Outcome = Champaran Agrarian Act 1918.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Sir Frank G. Sly (Commissioner of Central Provinces) was appointed राष्ट्रपति of the Champaran Agrarian Enquiry Committee by Lieutenant राज्यपाल Edward Gait. The committee unanimously recommended the abolition of the tinkathia system.
questions.tip_hi: Champaran Agrarian Committee: राष्ट्रपति = F. G. Sly; Member = महात्मा गांधी; Outcome = Champaran Agrarian Act 1918.

questions.en: In which year was the 'Bihar Provincial Congress Committee' formally constituted with its headquarters at Patna and Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan as President?
questions.hi: पटना में मुख्यालय और नवाब सरफराज हुसैन खान की अध्यक्षता में 'बिहार प्रांतीय कांग्रेस कमेटी' का औपचारिक गठन किस वर्ष हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In 1908, a meeting was held at Patna under Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan where the Bihar Provincial Congress Committee was formally constituted, choosing Syed Hasan Imam as its first permanent president.
questions.tip: Bihar Provincial Congress Committee formed = 1908 (Patna conference under Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: In 1908, a meeting में आयोजित किया गया था Patna under Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan where the Bihar Provincial Congress Committee was formally constituted, choosing Syed Hasan Imam as its first permanent राष्ट्रपति.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Provincial Congress Committee formed = 1908 (Patna conference under Nawab Sarfaraz Hussain Khan).

questions.en: After resigning from the Presidency of the Indian National Congress at the Tripuri Session in 1939, Subhas Chandra Bose founded which political party?
questions.hi: 1939 में त्रिपुरी अधिवेशन में कांग्रेस के अध्यक्ष पद से इस्तीफा देने के बाद सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने किस राजनीतिक दल की स्थापना की थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following ideological differences with Mahatma Gandhi and the Congress Working Committee, Subhas Chandra Bose resigned in April 1939 and announced the formation of the Forward Bloc within the Congress on 3 May 1939 at Makur, Unnao.
questions.tip: Subhas Chandra Bose founded Forward Bloc in 1939 (First All India Conference at Ramgarh, Bihar in 1940).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Following ideological differences with महात्मा गांधी and the Congress Working Committee, सुभाष चंद्र बोस resigned in अप्रैल 1939 and announced the formation of the Forward Bloc within the Congress on 3 मई 1939 at Makur, Unnao.
questions.tip_hi: सुभाष चंद्र बोस founded Forward Bloc in 1939 (First All India Conference at Ramgarh, Bihar in 1940).

questions.en: Who was the founder of the 'Ramakrishna Mission' established in 1897 to promote humanitarian relief and spiritual education?
questions.hi: 1897 में मानव सेवा और आध्यात्मिक शिक्षा के प्रसार हेतु 'रामकृष्ण मिशन' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission on 1 May 1897 at Belur Math near Kolkata, named after his spiritual guru Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.
questions.tip: Ramakrishna Mission (1897) = Swami Vivekananda; Arya Samaj (1875) = Dayananda Saraswati; Brahmo Samaj (1828) = Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: स्वामी विवेकानंद founded the Ramakrishna Mission on 1 मई 1897 at Belur Math near Kolkata, named after his spiritual guru Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.
questions.tip_hi: Ramakrishna Mission (1897) = स्वामी विवेकानंद; Arya Samaj (1875) = Dayananda Saraswati; Brahmo Samaj (1828) = राजा राममोहन राय.

questions.en: Which river is known as the 'Narayani' and 'Saptagandaki' in the Nepal Himalayas before entering the territory of Bihar at Valmikinagar?
questions.hi: नेपाल हिमालय में किस नदी को 'नारायणी' और 'सप्तगंडकी' के नाम से जाना जाता है, जो वाल्मीकिनगर से बिहार में प्रवेश करती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Gandak River (known in Nepal as the Saligrami or Narayani) enters Bihar at Valmikinagar in West Champaran and forms the boundary between Bihar and UP before discharging into the Ganga at Sonpur/Hajipur.
questions.tip: Gandak = Narayani / Saptagandaki; enters Bihar at Valmikinagar (West Champaran); famous for Saligram stones.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The गंडक नदी River (known in Nepal as the Saligrami or Narayani) enters Bihar at Valmikinagar in पश्चिम Champaran and forms the boundary between Bihar and UP before discharging into the गंगा नदी at Sonpur/Hajipur.
questions.tip_hi: गंडक नदी = Narayani / Saptagandaki; enters Bihar at Valmikinagar (पश्चिम Champaran); famous for Saligram stones.

questions.en: In which year was the 'All India Kisan Sabha' (AIKS) founded at the Lucknow session of the Congress with Swami Sahajanand Saraswati as President?(
questions.hi: कांग्रेस के लखनऊ अधिवेशन में किस वर्ष स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती की अध्यक्षता में 'अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा' (AIKS) की स्थापना हुई थी?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The All India Kisan Sabha was established on 11 April 1936 at the Lucknow Congress session. Swami Sahajanand Saraswati was elected President and Prof. N. G. Ranga was appointed General Secretary.
questions.tip: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha = 1929 (Sonepur); All India Kisan Sabha = 1936 (Lucknow).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The All India Kisan Sabha was established on 11 अप्रैल 1936 at the Lucknow Congress session. स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती was elected राष्ट्रपति and Prof. N. G. Ranga was appointed General Secretary.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha = 1929 (Sonepur); All India Kisan Sabha = 1936 (Lucknow).

questions.en: During the 1857 Revolt in Bihar, which three regiments of the Native Infantry stationed at Danapur Cantonment revolted on 25 July 1857 and marched to Arrah?
questions.hi: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान दानापुर छावनी में तैनात देशी इन्फैंट्री की किन तीन रेजीमेंटों ने 25 जुलाई 1857 को विद्रोह किया और आरा की ओर कूच किया?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: On 25 July 1857, the sepoy soldiers of the 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry regiments at Danapur revolted against General Lloyd, crossed the Son River, and joined Babu Kunwar Singh at Jagdishpur/Arrah.
questions.tip: Danapur mutiny regiments = 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry (25 July 1857).
options_hi: प्रथम (1ला), द्वितीय (2रा), and तृतीय (3रा) Bengal Light Cavalry
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: On 25 जुलाई 1857, the sepoy soldiers of the 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry regiments at Danapur revolted against General Lloyd, crossed the सोन नदी River, and joined बाबू कुंवर सिंह at Jagdishpur/Arrah.
questions.tip_hi: Danapur mutiny regiments = 7th, 8th, and 40th Native Infantry (25 जुलाई 1857).

questions.en: Who introduced the system of 'Permanent Settlement' (
questions.hi: इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त) of land revenue in Bengal and Bihar in 1793?(1793 में बंगाल और बिहार में भू-राजस्व की 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त) प्रणाली किसने लागू की थी?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lord Cornwallis enacted the Permanent Settlement in 1793 in Bengal and Bihar with John Shore. Zamindars were recognized as owners of the land with fixed revenue dues (10/11th to British Company, 1/11th to Zamindar).
questions.tip: Permanent Settlement (1793) = Lord Cornwallis (Bengal, Bihar, Orissa); Ryotwari = Thomas Munro; Mahalwari = Holt Mackenzie.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Lord Cornwallis enacted the Permanent Settlement in 1793 in Bengal and Bihar with John Shore. Zamindars were recognized as owners of the land with fixed revenue dues (10/11th to British Company, 1/11th to Zamindar).
questions.tip_hi: Permanent Settlement (1793) = Lord Cornwallis (Bengal, Bihar, Orissa); Ryotwari = Thomas Munro; Mahalwari = Holt Mackenzie.

questions.en: Who presided over the 37th Annual Session of the Indian National Congress held at Gaya in Bihar in December 1922?
questions.hi: दिसंबर 1922 में बिहार के गया में आयोजित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 37वें वार्षिक अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: C. R. Das presided over the 1922 Gaya Session. After his proposal for council entry was defeated by the 'No-Changers' (Rajendra Prasad, C. Rajagopalachari), he resigned and founded the Swaraj Party with Motilal Nehru.
questions.tip: Congress Sessions in Bihar: 1912 Bankipore (R. N. Mudholkar); 1922 Gaya (C. R. Das); 1940 Ramgarh (Abul Kalam Azad).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: C. R. Das presided over the 1922 Gaya Session. After his proposal for council entry was defeated by the 'No-Changers' (Rajendra Prasad, C. Rajagopalachari), he resigned and founded the Swaraj Party with Motilal Nehru.
questions.tip_hi: Congress Sessions in Bihar: 1912 Bankipore (R. N. Mudholkar); 1922 Gaya (C. R. Das); 1940 Ramgarh (Abul Kalam Azad).

questions.en: In which district of Bihar is the State's only National Park, the 'Valmiki National Park and Tiger Reserve', situated?
questions.hi: बिहार का एकमात्र राष्ट्रीय उद्यान 'वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान एवं बाघ अभयारण्य' किस जिले में स्थित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Valmiki National Park covers an area of approx. 335.65 sq km (and sanctuary area of 898 sq km) in the Terai region of West Champaran along the Gandak River and Nepal border, forming Project Tiger Reserve No. 18.
questions.tip: Only National Park of Bihar = Valmiki National Park (West Champaran).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान covers an area of approx. 335.65 sq किमी (and sanctuary area of 898 sq किमी) in the Terai region of पश्चिम Champaran along the गंडक नदी River and Nepal border, forming Project Tiger Reserve No. 18.
questions.tip_hi: Only National Park of Bihar = वाल्मीकि राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (पश्चिम Champaran).
